sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALL.  FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE PRO FOOTBALL TEAM AND WHERE IT'S HEADED THIS YEAR.       DO YOU AGREE WITH THE CALLER'S PREDICTION?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hey there!
ParticipantA: Yeah, I guess I called since we were asked to talk about pro football. I'm actually a librarian, so it's a bit weird for me to be calling about this.
ParticipantB: Haha, no worries! I'm a mechanic, so honestly, I feel like I know more about football than cars sometimes. What's your favorite team?
ParticipantA: Honestly, I don't really know. I've picked the same team for years, but it's just... I don't know, I made up my mind a long time ago without really knowing why.
ParticipantB: Oh, that happens! I've been a Cowboys fan since I was twelve, and I can't explain why, but every game matters to me. Where do you think they're headed this year?
ParticipantA: I feel like they're going to struggle again. Like, I just can't see them making the playoffs. It's just a gut feeling.
ParticipantB: Oh, really? I totally disagree. I think they're going to win the division easily. The new quarterback is firing on all cylinders, and the defense is actually playing well.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I know that too, but for some reason, I just don't feel right about it. Maybe it's just bad luck or something?
ParticipantB: Well, I can't say I've ever been wrong before, so I'm sticking with my gut. How about you, do you have any specific players you like?
ParticipantA: I mean, I used to love the running back, but now... I don't even know. It's just frustrating, you know?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. Sometimes you just want to see them struggle a bit before they turn it around. But I'm still hopeful.
ParticipantA: Yeah, maybe I'm just being too pessimistic. It's weird because I've had mixed feelings about it for years.
ParticipantB: Yeah, that's normal. Sometimes you just need a break from the team to reset. Do you ever think about switching to a new team?
ParticipantA: Probably not. I mean, I've been loyal to them, even if I'm not happy with how they're doing this year.
ParticipantB: That's cool. I've never switched, either. Even when they stink, I still show up. It's just part of the deal.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I guess it is. Thanks for talking to me, it was actually kind of nice to hear someone else's perspective.
ParticipantB: No problem! Good luck this season, even if you're not a believer. I'll see you around.
ParticipantA: Yeah, you too. Bye.
ParticipantB: Bye!
